title: More models, less repeated work
summary:
The model roster grew while caching, traffic controls, and small developer-tool fixes made the infrastructure easier to use.

GPT 5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna and Seedream 5 Pro joined the model roster. Gemini requests gained explicit prompt caching for large prefixes, cutting the cost of repeated hits by up to 94x. Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite endpoints also moved from the retired preview to the GA model.

The edge configuration changed across the week to reduce unexpected throttling while retaining production traffic controls. Proxy-header fixes improved client identification, and custom-domain routing was made consistent across Pollinations and Myceli services.

Sprout, the multi-model LLM Playground, and the WebGL shader studio /motion joined the community directory. Tomdacat’s listing was cleaned up and pointed to its new home for Roblox creators. Daily health and usage updates kept the directory’s view of the ecosystem current.

Polli CLI v0.1.6 added quest-reward tracking, including filters for pending and claimed Pollen. Its installation docs now give the current npm command, and cached model-health responses speed up status checks. App-directory contributions also moved from legacy tier upgrades to a flat 5 Pollen reward claimed through the Contribute a pull request Quest after a merge.
